headline: As of 2026-10-27: 35,135,733 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+10.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 35,135,733 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+10.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (5,166,919), California (3,595,843), Florida (3,388,375).
